title: Film
subtitle: 「電影／影片／電影作品」，要先分清是在談一套完整電影、長片、電影業正式用語、藝術作品，還是某個特定類型如 documentary / short film / adaptation
description: 「電影／影片／電影作品」，要先分清是在談一套完整電影、長片、電影業正式用語、藝術作品，還是某個特定類型如 documentary / short film / adaptation。

words.example: We watched a movie after dinner.
words.exampleZh: 我們晚飯後看了一套電影。

exercises.original: We watched a film after dinner.
exercises.zh: 我們晚飯後看了一套電影。
exercises.upgrade: We watched a movie after dinner.

options.explanation: casual viewing of one complete film is naturally called a movie。
video is broader and could mean any recorded moving image。
episode is one instalment of a series。
trailer is only promotional footage。
clip is only a short excerpt。
series contains multiple instalments.

exercises.original: The film became very popular with younger audiences.
exercises.zh: 這套電影在年輕觀眾中很受歡迎。
exercises.upgrade: The movie became very popular with younger audiences.

options.explanation: one complete cinema work can naturally be called a movie。
episode implies a serial programme。
trailer is promotional material。
video only is too broad and less precise。
cinema is the medium/venue, not the individual work。
clip is only part of a work.

exercises.original: They are making a new film in the city this summer.
exercises.zh: 他們今年夏天正在市內拍攝一套新電影。
exercises.upgrade: They are making a new movie in the city this summer.

options.explanation: making one complete screen story is naturally making a movie。
series would imply multiple instalments。
episode is only one instalment。
clip and trailer are short pieces, not the whole production。
cinema is the medium/venue.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The museum has an exhibition on the early motion-picture industry.
words.exampleZh: 博物館有一個關於早期電影業的展覽。

exercises.original: The museum has an exhibition on the early film industry.
exercises.zh: 博物館有一個關於早期電影業的展覽。
exercises.upgrade: The museum has an exhibition on the early motion-picture industry.

options.explanation: historical/formal industry context suits the term motion picture。
video is a broader modern medium term。
episode is a serial unit。
trailer and clip are fragments。
series is a multi-part format.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The archive preserves important films from the 1920s.
exercises.zh: 檔案館保存二十年代的重要電影作品。
exercises.upgrade: The archive preserves important motion pictures from the 1920s.

options.explanation: historical archive + 1920s makes motion pictures natural and period-appropriate。
videos is anachronistic/broader for early cinema works。
episodes imply serial content。
trailers/clips are not complete works。
series refers to grouped works.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The law was written to regulate the production of films.
exercises.zh: 法例用以規管電影製作。
exercises.upgrade: The law was written to regulate motion-picture production.

options.explanation: formal regulatory wording naturally uses motion-picture production。
video clips are only short footage。
episodes are a different format。
trailers are promotional pieces。
series are multi-part works。
cinema seats are physical venue items, not productions.

words.example: This was the director's first feature film.
words.exampleZh: 這是該導演的第一部長片。

exercises.original: This was the director's first full-length film.
exercises.zh: 這是導演第一部長片。
exercises.upgrade: This was the director's first feature film.

options.explanation: full-length + director's first complete cinema work directly indicates feature film。
short film is shorter than feature length。
trailer and clip are fragments。
episode belongs to a series。
series is multiple works/episodes.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The festival includes both short films and full-length films.
exercises.zh: 影展同時包括短片和長片。
exercises.upgrade: The festival includes both short films and feature films.

options.explanation: direct contrast with short films makes feature films the correct category。
trailers/clips are promotional or excerpt material。
episodes are serial units。
videos only is too broad。
series refers to grouped instalments.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Her feature-length film will be released in cinemas next month.
exercises.zh: 她的長片將於下月在戲院上映。
exercises.upgrade: Her feature film will be released in cinemas next month.

options.explanation: feature-length + cinema release identifies a feature film。
episode is part of a series。
trailer and clip are not full-length works。
series is multi-part。
video is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The project began as a television idea but became a cinema feature.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目最初是電視構思，後來發展成影院長片。

exercises.original: The television idea was eventually developed into a film for cinema release.
exercises.zh: 這個電視構思最終發展成影院長片。
exercises.upgrade: The television idea was eventually developed into a cinema feature.

options.explanation: the contrast with television and explicit cinema release supports cinema feature。
episode is episodic television/series content。
trailer and clip are short material。
series is multi-part。
video is too broad and does not imply cinema release.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The project is intended as a film for theatrical release.
exercises.zh: 這個項目預計製作成院線長片。
exercises.upgrade: The project is intended as a cinema feature for theatrical release.

options.explanation: theatrical release + full project fits cinema feature。
episode and series imply serial structure。
online clip is too short。
trailer is promotional only。
video is broader.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The director moved from television into films made for cinemas.
exercises.zh: 導演由電視轉向影院長片製作。
exercises.upgrade: The director moved from television into cinema features.

options.explanation: moving from television to full cinema works is naturally expressed as cinema features。
episodes and series are television/serial formats。
clips/trailers are not complete films。
videos is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The studio released several successful pictures that year.
words.exampleZh: 那間製片公司當年推出數套成功電影。

exercises.original: The studio released several successful films that year.
exercises.zh: 製片公司當年推出數套成功電影。
exercises.upgrade: The studio released several successful pictures that year.

options.explanation: studio + released + historical/industry tone allows pictures as an older film term。
episodes are serial units。
videos is broader and less period-specific。
trailers/clips are fragments。
series is multiple connected works.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The old studio was once one of the biggest names in the film business.
exercises.zh: 這間舊製片公司曾是電影業的重要名字之一。
exercises.upgrade: The old studio was once one of the biggest names in the picture business.

options.explanation: picture business is an older industry expression for the film business。
video business is broader and modern。
episode/trailer/clip business are not standard equivalents。
series business is not the same industry label.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The actor appeared in more than thirty films.
exercises.zh: 這位演員參演過三十多套電影。
exercises.upgrade: The actor appeared in more than thirty pictures.

options.explanation: older/industry usage permits pictures for complete films。
episodes are parts of serials。
trailers/clips are not full roles in complete films。
series counts collections rather than individual films。
videos only is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: Critics regard it as one of the director's strongest cinematic works.
words.exampleZh: 影評人視它為該導演最出色的電影作品之一。

exercises.original: Critics regard the film as one of the director's strongest works.
exercises.zh: 影評人視它為導演最出色的電影作品之一。
exercises.upgrade: Critics regard it as one of the director's strongest cinematic works.

options.explanation: critical/artistic evaluation of a director's oeuvre suits cinematic work。
episode is a serial instalment。
trailer and video clip are fragments。
series is a collection。
cinema venue is a place, not a work.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The film is studied for its unusual visual style.
exercises.zh: 這部電影因其獨特視覺風格而受到研究。
exercises.upgrade: The cinematic work is studied for its unusual visual style.

options.explanation: visual style + artistic analysis supports cinematic work。
clip/trailer are only partial materials。
episode is a serial unit。
series is multiple works。
cinema is the medium/venue, not this individual work.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Her latest film represents a major change in her artistic direction.
exercises.zh: 她最新的電影作品代表其藝術方向的重要轉變。
exercises.upgrade: Her latest cinematic work represents a major change in her artistic direction.

options.explanation: artistic direction + latest work supports formal cinematic work。
video only is too broad and less art-critical。
episode/trailer/clip are not the full work。
series is multiple instalments.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The grant supports independent screen productions.
words.exampleZh: 該資助支援獨立螢幕作品。

exercises.original: The grant supports independent films and television projects.
exercises.zh: 該資助支援獨立電影及電視項目。
exercises.upgrade: The grant supports independent screen productions.

options.explanation: the category must cover both film and television, so screen productions is appropriate。
trailers/clips are only parts or promotional materials。
episodes only is too narrow。
cinema buildings are venues。
posters are promotional print media.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The company works across film, television, and streaming.
exercises.zh: 公司業務涵蓋電影、電視和串流。
exercises.upgrade: The company works across different types of screen production.

options.explanation: film + television + streaming requires a broader screen-media term。
film only excludes television/streaming productions。
episode only is too narrow。
trailers/clips are fragments。
cinema is the medium/venue.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The fund is open to new film and screen projects.
exercises.zh: 該基金接受新的電影及螢幕製作項目申請。
exercises.upgrade: The fund is open to new screen productions.

options.explanation: funding category for screen works can naturally use screen productions。
episodes only excludes other forms。
trailers/clips are not full productions。
cinema seats and posters are not screen works.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The novel was adapted into a screen drama.
words.exampleZh: 這本小說被改編成一部銀幕劇作。

exercises.original: The novel was adapted into a film with a dramatic storyline.
exercises.zh: 這本小說被改編成一部銀幕劇作。
exercises.upgrade: The novel was adapted into a screen drama.

options.explanation: novel adaptation + dramatic storyline fits screen drama。
documentary is non-fiction。
trailer and clip are partial materials。
episode necessarily would require a series format。
video only is too broad and non-specific.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The film tells a fictional story about a family during wartime.
exercises.zh: 這部電影講述戰時一個家庭的虛構故事。
exercises.upgrade: The screen drama tells a fictional story about a family during wartime.

options.explanation: fictional dramatic story is exactly a screen drama。
documentary/news report are factual forms。
trailer/clip are not full works。
series necessarily adds episodic structure not stated.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The director is best known for historical films with strong characters.
exercises.zh: 導演最擅長以鮮明人物為主的歷史劇作。
exercises.upgrade: The director is best known for historical screen dramas with strong characters.

options.explanation: historical + strong fictional characters points to dramatic screen works。
documentaries necessarily would imply non-fiction。
trailers/clips are fragments。
episodes only narrows to series content。
videos is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The film production employed more than one hundred local crew members.
words.exampleZh: 這項電影製作聘用了超過一百名本地工作人員。

exercises.original: The film employed more than one hundred local crew members.
exercises.zh: 這項電影製作聘用了超過一百名本地工作人員。
exercises.upgrade: The film production employed more than one hundred local crew members.

options.explanation: crew employment refers to the production project/process, not merely the finished work。
trailer/clip are short outputs。
episode/series are different formats。
cinema is a venue/medium.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The film went over budget during shooting.
exercises.zh: 電影在拍攝期間超出預算。
exercises.upgrade: The film production went over budget during shooting.

options.explanation: budget + during shooting refers to production activity。
screening is exhibition, not making the film。
episode/trailer/clip are different outputs。
cinema is not the production process.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The studio moved the film to another country for tax reasons.
exercises.zh: 製片公司因稅務原因把電影製作移到另一國家。
exercises.upgrade: The studio moved the film production to another country for tax reasons.

options.explanation: moving location for tax reasons concerns where production takes place。
screening concerns exhibition。
trailer/clip are not the whole production。
episode is a serial unit。
cinema feature only names the final type, not production activity.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 螢幕長片；長篇影像作品
words.example: The short story was expanded into a full-length screen feature.
words.exampleZh: 這篇短篇故事被擴展成一部長篇螢幕作品。

exercises.original: The short story was expanded into a full-length film.
exercises.zh: 短篇故事被擴展成長篇螢幕作品。
exercises.upgrade: The short story was expanded into a full-length screen feature.

options.explanation: full-length narrative expansion supports screen feature。
clip/trailer are short fragments。
episode belongs to a serial work。
series is multiple instalments。
short film contradicts full-length.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The project began as a short but later became a full film.
exercises.zh: 項目最初是短片，後來發展成長篇作品。
exercises.upgrade: The project began as a short but later became a screen feature.

options.explanation: contrast with a short indicates a full-length feature。
trailer/clip remain short forms。
episode is episodic。
series is multi-part。
video only is too broad.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The director is preparing a full-length film for streaming release.
exercises.zh: 導演正準備一部供串流上映的長篇作品。
exercises.upgrade: The director is preparing a full-length screen feature for streaming release.

options.explanation: full-length + streaming release still fits a screen feature。
clip/trailer are fragments。
episode/series imply serial structure。
short film contradicts full-length.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The film is a documentary about coastal communities.
words.exampleZh: 這套電影是一部關於沿岸社群的紀錄片。

exercises.original: The film examines real coastal communities and uses interviews with residents.
exercises.zh: 這部電影透過居民訪談探討真實沿岸社群。
exercises.upgrade: The film is a documentary about coastal communities.

options.explanation: real communities + interviews is a direct non-fiction documentary clue。
screen drama would imply dramatic fictionalisation。
trailer/clip are not full works。
episode/series are format categories not required.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The film uses archive footage to tell the history of the city.
exercises.zh: 這部電影利用歷史檔案片段講述城市歷史。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary uses archive footage to tell the history of the city.

options.explanation: archive footage + factual history strongly supports documentary。
fiction film would invent or dramatise rather than primarily document facts。
trailer/clip are fragments。
episode necessarily adds serial structure。
series is multiple instalments.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The director spent two years filming wildlife for the film.
exercises.zh: 導演花了兩年拍攝野生動物製作紀錄片。
exercises.upgrade: The director spent two years filming wildlife for the documentary.

options.explanation: long-term real wildlife filming is classic documentary production。
screen drama is fictional/dramatic。
trailer/clip are short materials。
episode/series are not implied.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The students produced a short film for the festival.
words.exampleZh: 學生為影展製作了一部短片。

exercises.original: The students produced a film lasting eight minutes.
exercises.zh: 學生製作了一部八分鐘短片。
exercises.upgrade: The students produced an eight-minute short film.

options.explanation: eight-minute runtime directly identifies a short film。
feature film/cinema feature are full-length。
series is multiple works。
episode is part of a serial。
trailer is promotional rather than a standalone short work.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The festival has a category for films under twenty minutes.
exercises.zh: 影展設有二十分鐘以下短片組別。
exercises.upgrade: The festival has a category for short films under twenty minutes.

options.explanation: under twenty minutes is a clear short-film category clue。
feature films are much longer。
series/episodes are serial formats。
trailers are promotional materials。
motion pictures only is too broad and does not identify the short category.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: She won an award for her first student film.
exercises.zh: 她憑第一部學生短片獲獎。
exercises.upgrade: She won an award for her first student short film.

options.explanation: student film context commonly involves a short, and the target explicitly narrows the form。
feature/cinema feature are full-length。
series/episode imply serial production。
trailer is promotional.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.meaning: 銀幕改編作品；影視改編
words.example: The film is a screen adaptation of a bestselling novel.
words.exampleZh: 這套電影改編自一本暢銷小說。

exercises.original: The film is based on a bestselling novel.
exercises.zh: 這部電影改編自一本暢銷小說。
exercises.upgrade: The film is a screen adaptation of a bestselling novel.

options.explanation: based on a novel directly identifies an adaptation for the screen。
documentary is a non-fiction genre, not necessarily adapted from a novel。
trailer/clip are fragments。
episode would require serial format。
original screenplay is the opposite source relationship.

exercises.original: The film adapts a stage play for cinema audiences.
exercises.zh: 這部電影把舞台劇改編給電影觀眾。
exercises.upgrade: The film is a screen adaptation of a stage play.

options.explanation: adapted from a stage play is exactly a screen adaptation。
documentary is unrelated to source adaptation。
series necessarily adds format not stated。
trailer/clip are not the full adapted work。
original film would contradict adaptation.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The director's latest film comes from a popular video game.
exercises.zh: 導演最新電影改編自熱門電子遊戲。
exercises.upgrade: The director's latest film is a screen adaptation of a popular video game.

options.explanation: comes from a video game indicates source adaptation。
documentary would imply factual non-fiction。
original screenplay contradicts being adapted from a game。
trailer/clip are fragments。
episode is a serial unit.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

falseSynonyms.zh: 影片不等於 film video 是更廣的動態影像形式，可包括短片、教學片、社交平台影片等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Video is broader than film.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一集不等於 film episode 通常是系列節目、電視劇、播客中的一集；film 通常是一套完整作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An episode is one instalment in a series.

falseSynonyms.zh: 預告片不等於 film trailer 是宣傳用短片，展示部分內容；不是完整電影。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A trailer promotes a film.

falseSynonyms.zh: 片段不等於 film clip 是一小段影片；film 是完整作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A clip is only part of a film or video.

falseSynonyms.zh: 系列不等於 film series 是多集或多部組成的系列；film 通常是一個完整作品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A series contains multiple instalments.

falseSynonyms.zh: 電影院／電影藝術不等於一套 film cinema 可指電影藝術、電影業或電影院；film 是作品本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cinema can mean the medium, industry, or venue.

falseSynonyms.zh: feature 單獨不一定等於 film feature 有很多其他意思；只有在 film/media 語境中才可能表示 feature film。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Feature needs context to mean a full-length film.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 film 可作名詞或動詞；filming 是拍攝過程。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A film is the work; filming is the process of shooting.
